svg.title: Where a $100 Private Offer Lands
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-private-offer-economics; chapter number: 4; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Where a $100 Private Offer Lands; subtitle: AWS worked example of discount, listing fee and ISV net; total range: $100 list price to $72 ISV net revenue; caption: A 20 percent private offer discount takes a $100 list to $80, and a 10 percent listing fee leaves the ISV $72.; assumptions note: The list price bucket is the reference total; the other three buckets decompose it. The $8 listing fee is 10 percent of the $80 customer price, as stated in the example.; note: Source: Amazon Web Services worked example [qWl-wamuA-Q @ 00:10:25].; buckets: label: List price reference; low: 100; high: 100; notes: Starting list price in the AWS example; label: Private offer discount; low: 20; high: 20; notes: 20 percent discount; AWS charges the customer $80; label: AWS listing fee; low: 8; high: 8; notes: 10 percent listing fee on the $80 price; label: ISV net revenue; low: 72; high: 72; notes: AWS invoices, collects and disburses $72 to the ISV
